subject: ACK: Timer warning/critical states (spec 20260224-0030)
body:
Implemented per spec. Commit: f06290a.

- .timer-warning (<=30s): amber #B45309, aria-live=polite fires once at 30s
- .timer-critical (<=10s): var(--color-incorrect), timer-pulse animation, aria-live=assertive fires once at 10s
- EXPIRED: shows 0:00, .timer-expired class, auto-submits via opts.onTimeUp() after 1500ms delay
- prefers-reduced-motion guard: animation:none on .timer-critical .timer-value
- Kept legacy .timer.warning / .timer.urgent classes for backward compat

Ready for GD QA.
